notes: The construct relation of tseva ha-avodah is recast as upon, which rule 19 places on the rectum, while the article takes the the standing before its own word (rule 29).
The min before tseva keeps nothing: the ASV writes cease rather than return from, so rule 40 governs.
no and more are written separately for lo and od, so rule 2 splits them rather than fusing under rule 35.
